svg.title: About — Engineer. Developer. Data Thinker.
svg.desc: I'm Ismail Salha, a Computer & Intelligent Systems Engineer from Gaza, Palestine, working across machine learning, data analysis, web development and cybersecurity. I enjoy turning raw data into clear insight, training and evaluating models honestly, and shipping fast, accessible web interfaces that people actually like to use. Outside my own projects I'm an IEEE Student Member (Palestine Subsection) and a Core Team member of GDGoC Al-Aqsa, helping grow the local tech community.
